name: setup-manaflow-ai-grove-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, with a palette sampled from moss, lichen, bark and morning fog. A theme file gives each appearance its own colors and its own painting from cmux's art catalog behind frosted glass; settings pair a book serif with a humanist sans and slow the motion; a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens paints the prompt and cards for light and dark; a customize view gives the sidebar a field-note hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Grove sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Grove's hover card and sidebar rows: a frosted header, the task in full, and calm rows with the arc while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/grove.json:
// Grove: a forest look. By day, unbleached paper under moss-green ink, with frosted morning air
// over Van Gogh's cypresses; by night, a deep fern dark over Friedrich's moonlit forest. Every color
// is sampled from moss, lichen, bark, fog and earth pigments, and checked for contrast in DESIGN.md.
{
  "name": "Grove",
  "description": "Unbleached paper by day, night forest by dark; moss accent, frosted-air sidebar, a painted grove behind the glass.",

  // One terminal theme per appearance, and cmux's own surfaces follow it.
  "appearance.theme": "light:Builtin Light,dark:Builtin Dark",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // Each appearance's own colors. A theme file's `colors` would paint both sides alike, so the look
  // edits each side of the pair by name: paper, ink, a lichen selection, the moss accent, an ochre
  // cursor, and sixteen earth-pigment terminal colors (red ochre, moss, yellow ochre, slate,
  // heather, lichen teal).
  "appearance.themeEdits": {
    "Builtin Light/background": "#f4f0e4",
    "Builtin Light/foreground": "#2b3326",
    "Builtin Light/selection": "#dfe4cb",
    "Builtin Light/accent": "#4a6a2c",
    "Builtin Light/cursor": "#a26d23",
    "Builtin Light/0": "#3a4033",
    "Builtin Light/1": "#a3412b",
    "Builtin Light/2": "#4f7229",
    "Builtin Light/3": "#8a6312",
    "Builtin Light/4": "#3a687a",
    "Builtin Light/5": "#874f6e",
    "Builtin Light/6": "#336f5f",
    "Builtin Light/7": "#c9c3ad",
    "Builtin Light/8": "#646a59",
    "Builtin Light/9": "#b24a31",
    "Builtin Light/10": "#52762a",
    "Builtin Light/11": "#8d6317",
    "Builtin Light/12": "#3f7186",
    "Builtin Light/13": "#935a7a",
    "Builtin Light/14": "#367463",
    "Builtin Light/15": "#e9e4d3",
    "Builtin Dark/background": "#151c16",
    "Builtin Dark/foreground": "#dfd9c6",
    "Builtin Dark/selection": "#697a6a",
    "Builtin Dark/accent": "#a7c080",
    "Builtin Dark/cursor": "#d6a85c",
    "Builtin Dark/0": "#2b342b",
    "Builtin Dark/1": "#e07a62",
    "Builtin Dark/2": "#a7c080",
    "Builtin Dark/3": "#dbb46a",
    "Builtin Dark/4": "#7fa9b8",
    "Builtin Dark/5": "#c895b0",
    "Builtin Dark/6": "#83c0a0",
    "Builtin Dark/7": "#d9d3bf",
    "Builtin Dark/8": "#7c8671",
    "Builtin Dark/9": "#ef8f76",
    "Builtin Dark/10": "#b9d394",
    "Builtin Dark/11": "#e8c582",
    "Builtin Dark/12": "#94bccb",
    "Builtin Dark/13": "#d8a9c2",
    "Builtin Dark/14": "#9ad3b4",
    "Builtin Dark/15": "#f2eddc"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The painted grove behind the glass: one picture per appearance, both from cmux's art catalog.
  "appearance.background": "appearance",
  "appearance.backgroundLight": "van-gogh-wheat-field-cypresses",
  "appearance.backgroundDark": "friedrich-forest-moonlight",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.84,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "frosted",
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // The window: a soft separate sidebar shade beside one curved card. The sidebar keeps the
  // window's frosted glass (no surface override); the chat and terminals are near-solid paper.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "two-tone",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.97,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.95,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  // Motion: calm and slow, paint only. Colors blend over 320 ms (light to dark reads as one dusk),
  // and the app's animations run at their normal, not fast, speed.
  "ui.animationSpeed": "normal",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 320,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeInOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab"
}
